# Member Execution Routing Template

Copy this file to `docs/team/MEMBER_N.md` in an actual challenge repository and
fill only the routing details that are useful for that team member.

> `execute.md` is the canonical live execution state. This file is routing only.
> It must not override approved requirements, design, verification findings, or
> the live workstream record.

- **Integration responsibility (optional):**
- **Current next-action reference:** Link or identifier from `execute.md`.
- **Assignment Checkpoint (optional):** Last reconciled against `execute.md` at

If this routing conflicts with `execute.md`, report routing drift and use
`execute.md`; do not silently reconcile or invent an assignment.
